disclaimer: Planning aid, not advice. Every return here is your own assumption run through arithmetic; private deals can and do go to zero.

deploy_return_range.label: Return Range (per year)
deploy_return_range.plain: Low · base · high yearly return for this bucket, from YOUR inputs. Base is the honest middle; low and high are a bad and a good version of the same deal, not the worst and best imaginable.

thresholds.verdict: Compare buckets on the BASE number, then look at how far LOW falls

deploy_return_range.action: A wide range is the risk. If you could not live with the low case, shrink the bucket rather than hoping for the base case.

deploy_vs_hurdle.label: Versus Your Hurdle
deploy_vs_hurdle.plain: Your hurdle is the return you could get with no effort and little risk — paying down a loan, or a Treasury bill. Money should only leave it for something expected to beat it.

clears.verdict: Beats the hurdle even in the low case

likely.verdict: Beats it on the base case, not the low case

misses.verdict: Below the hurdle on the base case

deploy_vs_hurdle.action: A bucket that misses is taking risk or effort for less than the safe option pays. Fix the assumptions or move the money.

deploy_risk.label: Risk Level
deploy_risk.plain: How likely this is to lose money, on one scale for every kind of asset so a flip and a fund can sit side by side.

1.verdict: Very low — insured cash, Treasuries, paying off debt

2.verdict: Low — bonds, CDs past the insurance limit

3.verdict: Medium — diversified stocks, a financed rental

4.verdict: High — a flip, a single stock, a leveraged deal

5.verdict: Very high — can go to zero: startups, private deals

deploy_risk.action: Each type starts at a sensible level; change it under More assumptions when your deal is safer or riskier than typical.

deploy_liquidity.label: Time To Get Cash Back
deploy_liquidity.plain: How long it takes to turn this back into spendable money without taking a beating. The thing people underestimate most after a win.

weeks.verdict: A few weeks of notice or settlement

months.verdict: Needs a sale: listing, buyer, closing

locked.verdict: No exit until the deal ends

deploy_liquidity.action: Anything you might need within a year belongs in a 'days' bucket.

deploy_effort.label: Your Time
deploy_effort.plain: Hours of your own life each month. A return that needs a second job is partly a wage, not an investment return.

full.verdict: A second job — about 80 hours a month

deploy_effort.action: Price your time: subtract what those hours are worth before comparing against a hands-off bucket.

deploy_concentration.label: Biggest Bucket
deploy_concentration.plain: The share of the allocated money sitting in the single largest bucket. One deal going wrong should not undo the win.

thresholds.verdict: Most of the money rides on one outcome

deploy_concentration.action: Above the warning line, ask what happens to the plan if this one bucket has its low case.

deploy_illiquid_share.label: Hard To Reach
deploy_illiquid_share.plain: The share of the allocated money that would take months or longer to get back.

thresholds.verdict: More than half is tied up
Nearly all of it is tied up

deploy_illiquid_share.action: Keep an emergency fund and any money due for taxes on the win OUTSIDE the tied-up buckets.

deploy_end_value.label: Projected Value
deploy_end_value.plain: What the allocated money becomes by your horizon. Each bucket earns its own rate until it finishes, then your reinvest rate. The low and high figures are bookends — every bucket having its bad (or good) case at once — not a forecast range.

thresholds.verdict: Compare against the hurdle line: what the same money makes doing the safe thing

deploy_end_value.action: If base is barely above the hurdle value, the plan is taking risk for little extra.
